## Controller 1.0.51 (84)
- **3D simulator view.** The Simulator panel has a 2D/3D toggle that puts the running simulator in a lit 3D device model, including the iPhone Duo with a working fold. Touches, drags and typing pass through to the device. Reduce Motion is honored. - **Select Mode.** Point at any element in the simulator to see its frame and accessibility details, then send it to the chat as context. - **Agent cursor.** When an agent taps or swipes the simulator, a cursor shows where it is acting. - **New tools: generate_icon, search_docs and read_docs.** Agents can generate app icons into the project and search and read Apple developer documentation. - **Built-in skills.** Claude Code and Codex threads start with Controller's 15 built-in skills (SwiftUI, App Intents, animation and more). You can turn this off in Settings. - **Simulator stability fix.** Controller now fixes a PosterBoard crash when an iOS simulator boots. - **Connect pauses offline Macs.** A Mac that goes offline is paused until it reports in again. It stays resumable, and the environment switcher updates when a pause changes.

## Controller 1.0.51 (83)
- **Heartbeats steer busy threads.** A scheduled heartbeat that fires while a thread is working now steers the running turn instead of piling up identical queued prompts. Repeat ticks coalesce into one. - **Scheduled prompts settle only after delivery.** A one-shot heartbeat or PR watch whose prompt fails to reach its thread stays armed and reports the same activity again next time, instead of being marked done. - **Remote send_to_thread follows the local delivery rules.** Unsupported delivery modes are refused with an explanation instead of sending some other way. - **New simulator_run tool.** Agents can build the checkout's app and open it in Controller's Simulator panel without Xcode's Device Hub opening.

## Controller 1.0.51 (82)
- **Device frames:** The Simulator panel shows each simulator inside its real device frame, drawn from Xcode's own artwork, for every iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch Xcode supports. Screens get their true corners and notches, and the iPhone Duo's frame turns with its inner screen when open. - **Apple Watch simulators:** The Simulator panel now lists watchOS simulators, with live screen, touches and swipes. Home presses the Digital Crown. Agent simulator tools still work with iOS simulators only. - **iPad simulators:** iPads no longer show sideways in the Simulator panel. - **Agents in the simulator:** An agent's simulator session no longer ends after a minute of thinking between steps. On iOS 27, agents can tap items on screens such as Settings → General that were wrongly treated as covered. Snapshots leave out the keyboard's individual keys and the previous screen after a full screen change, so agents read less noise. A keyboard or alert check with nothing to report no longer fails. - **Worked for:** A running turn on a thread that has used more than one account no longer shows an early "Worked for" label or treats a progress message as the final answer.
